articles.title: Anthropic Expands Access to Claude Mythos After AI Giant Files for IPO
articles.snippet: Just a day after the nearly $1 trillion AI giant revealed IPO plans, Anthropic is letting more firms access its powerful Claude Mythos model.

articles.title: AI Giant Anthropic Files to Go Public After Nearing $1 Trillion Valuation
